correctness.rationale: For p>3, F_p^× scaling of S annihilates both degree-one and degree-two moments; since |S|=p^5-p^3+p^2 is 0 in F_p, the seven-generator Gram matrix is zero. For p=3 the source complete enumerator has weights 144,153,162,225, all multiples of three; self-dot=weight mod 3 and polarization give all inner products zero. In the unpunctured code Gram(u,v)=Tr(b)Tr(b' ), and trace surjectivity gives one-dimensional Gram rank, hence hull dimension 6. The argument assumes source dimension 7; a finite check alone is not a universal proof.
